input: I really enjoy playing badminton on weekends.
My cat Mochi sleeps on my keyboard every morning.
Weekends are great for badminton, I played again today.
Mochi the cat knocked over a cup of coffee just now.
I went badminton training this Saturday, still love it.
Coffee from the broken cup stained the desk badly.
Actually I switched to tennis on weekends instead of badminton.
Mochi is a very playful cat and chases every toy.
Tennis is my new weekend sport, badminton is over for me.
I bought a second cat named Mochi Junior last week.
The weather was perfect for outdoor sports this month.
My friend lent me a tennis racket for the season.
